  "title": "The Attic Melody",
  "body": "Beneath a shroud of suffocating dust, the forgotten music box began to turn on its own. A fragile, tinny lullaby drifted through the rafters, accompanied by the gentle scrape of settling rust. The Campfire Keeper watched as a phantom hand lifted a cracked porcelain teacup, sipping from a void where no drinker sat.",

  "tampering": false,

    "lullaby",
    "rust",
    "teacup"
  ]
}
